Seconding this 👆🏽 haven’t seen Micah’s bot but definitely needs more automation I think some discord anti-spam bots require users to solve a captcha upon entry And then they have a minimum wait time before they can speak I haven't seen much luck with those, and I *have* seen a large number of legitimate users foiled by them (usually new to Discord and don't understand where to look to get through the captcha). <@!301186049323958275> your bot is running now: <@!850461024691683348>
